title: ICC-ES ESR-5053: Sterling TerraLam cross-laminated timber (CLT) panels

facts.text: Report holder STERLING SITE ACCESS SOLUTIONS, LLC; subject is TerraLam CLT panels.
Under the 2021, 2018 and 2015 IBC: floors, roofs and interior walls in Type III; floors, roofs, interior and exterior walls in Types IV and V; Types I and II as allowed by IBC §603.
Shear-wall use requires detailing of the load paths in accordance with Appendix B of the 2021 SDPWS.

Cutting, drilling and notching of floor and roof-deck panels are outside the evaluation; wall use for gravity or out-of-plane loads needs complete detailing and wall design acceptable to the code official.
Exterior wall surfaces must be protected by a weather-resistant exterior finish.
Panels are fabricated at Sterling Structural's facility in Phoenix, Illinois.
Evidence listed: ICC-ES AC455, dated October 2022.
